name: Out
source:
On a Friday night in an underground fight club, reigning champion Bruiser locks eyes with his latest contender, Fleetfoot, as they face off in their first and final match.

周五夜晚的地下搏击俱乐部里，卫冕冠军“重拳”与最新登场的挑战者“疾步”四目相对——两人即将迎来他们之间第一场、也是最后一场对决。
